notes.title: Important Update
notes.content:
Numerous players have already tried their hand at the construction of the Berlin airport in probably the most realistic simulation ever. But internal tests showed that the game contained an annoying programming error that made the opening of the airport impossible and drove armies of gamers to despair. Such bugs are not uncommon - even the real BER was affected by this problem for years. With the current update you can now bring your own construction work to a successful end just in time for the real BER opening and be celebrated as a construction and planning genius.

The changes at a glance:

- Fixed a bug that made the opening of the airport impossible
- Annual inflation reduced from 10% to 8%.
- Three brand new flaws added
